rows.en: Geez… making us worry like that!

Ah…

Hey, look! Is that Alien Baltan!?
Heh heh heh… It's too soon to celebrate! It's not over yet…
What!?
The attacks using buildings in every city were Alien Baltan's "Operation Bilgamo," come to take revenge on Earth!

Operation Bilgamo?

You can't mean… Alien Baltan, who was defeated by Ultraman, has come to take revenge on mankind?

Exactly!

We, Alien Guts, and Alien Baltan will begin indiscriminate attacks… We'll bring retribution down on all mankind!
We've blown up your missile base too! We won't let you!
Ultraseven's true identity… was our Dan!!

A messenger of peace, sent from the M78 Nebula to protect the Earth…

He's been fighting for this Earth, even sacrificing himself!

But now… this is his last battle! Dan has to go back to his own planet!

Dan…

Everyone, let's go!! Mankind must protect the Earth to the end with its own hands!
Dan, you mustn't fight! Leave the kaiju to me!!
Dan!
If you were feeling unwell, why didn't you just tell us?
Because Dan always fights ready to die!
"When the sun sets in the western sky… a single light will fly off into space! That will be me."
Is Dan going home dead? If so… then we Earthlings are the ones who killed Dan!
With his wounded body, he fought for mankind to the very, very end!
We're the ones who killed Dan! Such a good guy…

That's crazy!? Dan can't be dead!

Dan's alive! I know he's alive! He'll be watching over our Earth from far off in space!

And someday… he'll come back, healthy as ever!
Ultraseven vanished from before the people's eyes…
But even so… when danger visits this Earth again, perhaps our Ultraseven will come flying from out of nowhere.
Goodbye, Ultraseven! Farewell…
Ah… Isn't that Go!?
Man, you saved me! I was trying to rescue civilians and ended up trapped myself…
Don't tell me… there are others?

Yes… there are still other MAT members trapped inside the buildings!

We have to rescue them, fast…

I'm all right!

But the Captain…

he's probably trapped in one of the buildings! Let's rescue him, quick.

That was a nasty experience, huh? With the exits blocked, there was nothing I could do!

The robot monster Bilgamo… what a menace! All right… let's rescue Minami, Kishida and Ueno!

I'm fine!

What about Minami and Ueno? I see, not yet… All right, let's hurry and rescue them!

Whew… MAT nearly got wiped out, didn't we?

…!?

Stubborn things! There's still one left.

According to my horoscope… I'd be the last one rescued…

But… I never thought it'd actually come true. That's a kicker.
…!? Oh no!!
Uwaaaagh…
Kyaaaaah…
Ugh… What on earth is going on?
Defeat the fake Ultraseven!
Defeat all Robot Monster Bilgamos!
Defeat all Robot Monster Bilgamos and Kelbaans!
Defeat all Kelbaans!
Defeat the Space Ninja Alien Baltan and the Clone Alien Guts!
Any member of the Ultra Garrison is defeated
Dan Moroboshi is defeated…?
Furuhashi or Amagi is defeated
The Naager had boldly set down its colossal body right under the nose of the TDF Far East Base. But since landing, it had kept an eerie silence…

The Ultraseven we're after is Dan Moroboshi of the Ultra Garrison!

To accomplish our goal, we must not only wipe out the TDF but also defeat that Ultraseven…

Because once Seven is defeated, mankind will surely surrender at once!

To defeat Ultraseven, we need to uncover the secret of his beam lamp!
All right, we're entering Earth's gravitational field.
Captain! Furuhashi and Amagi, reporting back!
How did it go?
Nothing unusual!
Again?
Yeah… Geez, what a nasty prank! This is our fourth sortie, you know?
Hahaha… Now, don't grumble so much!

Here!

A package has arrived for Furuhashi! All the way from Africa.
Whaaat!?
From Africa?
Yes… and it's from a woman!
Ooh… What a beautiful gem!

Oh? There's a letter in here too, isn't there? Let's see…

"Dear Mr. Furuhashi, I hope you're well…"

Hey, hey… You shouldn't go sneaking a peek at other people's letters!

Let's see…

"This is something I received from a local dignitary when I traveled to Africa. It's a rare gem, so I'm sharing half with you.

It's not a very expensive gem, but I hear the locals wear it as a necklace.

I wonder how you'll use it, Mr. Furuhashi?"

Whoa… Nice going!

So this woman, you know? She's your, I mean…
No, no… This person is, you know, um… a friend of my sister's.
Your sister's friend, huh? I see, I see… And?
Quit pestering me about it…
Another alarm!
District 3, is it…?
It's a hoax, a hoax! Just ignore it!!

Furuhashi!

Don't jump to conclusions like that!! Even if all 1,000 out of 1,000 reports are false, it's our duty to sortie, isn't it!
Sir! That was careless of me!
Dan, Anne!!
Yes, sir!
Heading out!!
Haah…
That's strange.
Nothing seems out of the ordinary.
Was it someone's prank again?
Hmm…

…!?

Dan! What's that…!?
Who are you?
We are… the invincible Alien Guts, who have never lost a single battle!
